text: Register SocialUs with the NCMEC CyberTipline, switch off the manual form, enable Cloudflare CSAM scanning.
why: During beta apparent CSAM is reported through NCMEC's public CyberTipline form, which cannot take images; registration and hash scanning replace it. Entity specifics live in socialus-legal.
source: the 2026-10-05 ruling and 2026-10-06 (child-safety tier); the PM, 2026-10-11

text: Re-review paid tools now that budget opens: LaunchDarkly against our own flags, what a paid Vercel plan already gives, and whether GitHub needs upgrading. Run the saved prompt.
why: Beta held every new paid tool unless it replaced PM time; at go-live the PM will pay for services that help the platform perform, and plans to upgrade Vercel and perhaps GitHub (the PM, 2026-11-10). The LaunchDarkly review of 2026-11-10 held rollouts and automatic rollback for traffic and money.
